uk.s: Meet the new Krak Credit Card: up to 4% cashback on all purchases¹

Subject to credit approval and eligibility requirements. You must be at least 18 years old, be a U.S. resident, have a Krak account in good standing, and have an active and eligible Krakpass membership. Not available in Indiana, Maine, Massachusetts, or New York. The Krak Secured Card is also not available in the District of Columbia. Joining the waitlist does not guarantee approval, early access, or availability of either card.

Your cashback rate rises from 1% to up to 4% as your Krak Account balance grows. You’ll start at 1% when your Krak balance is under $1,000, and you’ll reach 4% at $150,000 or more. The 3%, 3.5%, and 4% rates apply to the first $10,000 in eligible purchases each month (then 2% thereafter). The more you grow with us, the more you earn back. Terms apply.
The Krak Credit Card earns up to 4% cashback on all purchases,1 paid in US dollars or bitcoin, with no points to chase.
Your cashback rate rises up to 4% as your Krak balance grows.1
Enjoy a complimentary metal card, and Visa Signature® benefits.
The card is available through Krakpass, a subscription with up to 4% stablecoin APY, fee-free trades* (up to $3K/month), and early feature access.
The Krak Credit Card waitlist is open today for US customers, with shipping expected in late 2026.
Credit is coming soon to Krak, and we built it to be different.

If rewards programs have ever left you more confused than rewarded, you’re not alone. In our July 2026 research, 64% of Americans said they’re frustrated by the complexity or expiration policies of traditional rewards programs, and 57% said they’d rather have straightforward cashback than points. So that’s exactly what we’re giving you.

Meet the Krak Credit Card: up to 4% cashback on all purchases,1 and a complimentary metal card that’s all yours. Exclusively through a Krakpass membership which costs $6.99 per month or $75.48 per year when billed annually ($6.29 per month).
Up to 4% cashback on all purchases1
Every purchase earns you cashback, up to 4%.1 No points to chase. No redemption restrictions. And your cashback is paid in cash or bitcoin, your choice.
Complimentary metal card
Crafted from 16g of recycled stainless steel, your Krak Credit Card comes at no extra charge. Choose Radial Black or Radial Copper.
Explore a little more with Visa Signature®
Hotel stays. Live music. Help planning your next trip.

Your Krak Credit Card runs on the Visa network, so you’ll enjoy Visa Signature® benefits including the Luxury Hotel Collection, Sofar Sounds and Visa Signature® Concierge. You also get added peace of mind with Zero Liability Protection and access to Travel and Emergency Assistance. Terms apply.
Get more with Krakpass

Your ability to apply for the card is just one of your Krakpass membership benefits. The Krak Credit Card is exclusively available to eligible Krakpass members, and membership starts at $6.29/month when paid yearly, or $6.99 monthly. Here’s what else comes with it:
Earn up to 4% APY. Earn 4% APY on eligible USDC and USDG stablecoin balances, compared with 3% for non-members.
Invest without trading fees. Choose from 700+ assets, with no trading fees on up to $3,000 in monthly volume (spreads apply).
Early access. Access new features ahead of non-members.
Membership is required for the card. Terms apply.
Everything in one app
Apply, manage your card controls, and track your cashback right in the Krak app, alongside your existing debit card, cash, and digital assets. One app, all of your assets.
Building credit?

If you’re new to credit or still building your history, we’re also opening a waitlist for the Krak Secured Card. Secure your credit limit with USDC and your security deposit earns, too, up to 4% APY.2 You will earn cashback on eligible purchases, and on-time payments may help you build credit over time.3
We’ll take it from here
Credit is coming. Reserve your spot and join the waitlist today, available to US customers through the Krak app.
Keep an eye on your inbox. When it’s your turn, we’ll send you everything you need to apply in the Krak app. The Krak Credit Card and Krak Secured Card are expected to begin shipping in early 2027.
Join the waitlist

The Krak Credit Card and Krak Secured Card are not yet available. Applications are not being accepted at this time. Credit Cards will be offered through Payward Interactive, Inc. (d/b/a Kraken) and Cardless, Inc. Cards to be issued by First Electronic Bank pursuant to a license from Visa U.S.A. Inc.

An active and eligible Krakpass membership is required to open and keep a Krak Credit Card or Krak Secured Card and to earn Cashback Rewards. If your Krakpass membership is canceled or becomes inactive, your card may be suspended and then closed. Krakpass is a separate subscription that renews automatically and requires recurring payments unless you cancel. Krakpass is free through February 1, 2027 with a new Krak Credit Card or Krak Secured Card.Krakpass costs $6.99 per month or $75.48 per year when billed annually ($6.29 per month). Krakpass benefits are provided by Payward Interactive, Inc. (d/b/a Kraken), not First Electronic Bank or Cardless, and may change. Full details will be provided prior to card issuance.

1Only Krak Credit Card and Krak Secured Card cardholders with an active and eligible Krakpass membership can earn Cashback Rewards. Cashback Rewards rates are based on your Assets on Platform (AOP) in your Krak account, and higher rates apply only up to a monthly purchase limit. We’ll share more when the cards become available.

2Subject to change. USDC locked as your security deposit will be enrolled in Krak auto-earn and continue to earn while locked. Auto-earn is offered by Payward Interactive, Inc. (d/b/a Kraken), not First Electronic Bank or Cardless. Rates are variable and may change at any time. Earnings don’t increase your credit limit or the amount locked.

3Building credit is dependent on responsible credit usage. Credit score(s) are dependent upon multiple factors that may positively or negatively impact your credit score. This product is not guaranteed to establish or improve your credit score. On-time payment history may have a positive impact on your credit score. Late payment may negatively impact your credit score. Credit activities will be reported to TransUnion®, Experian®, and Equifax®. Impact on your credit may vary, as credit scores are independently determined by credit bureaus based on a number of factors including the financial decisions you make with other financial services organizations.
The Krak Secured Card requires a security deposit of USDC locked in your Krak account. Additional terms and conditions apply. Full details will be provided prior to card issuance.

Cryptocurrency services are provided to US and US territory customers by Payward Interactive, Inc. (“PWI”) dba Kraken, a FinCEN registered money services business, a subsidiary of Payward, Inc. View PWI’s disclosures.

Geographic restrictions apply. Rewards rates are determined and paid out by Kraken in its sole discretion and are subject to change. See our Terms of Service for more info. Due to its partnership with Global Dollar Network and Circle, Kraken receives an economic benefit with respect to amounts of USDG and USDC minted, held on platform, and received in on-chain transfers.

Krak debit card is issued by Lead Bank pursuant to a license from Visa U.S.A. Inc. Krak is a financial technology company, not a bank. Account balances are not FDIC- or SIPC-insured. Digital assets converted to USD at purchase; values may fluctuate. Available to eligible U.S. residents only; not available in all states. See terms.
See Visa benefits terms for details.
The post Meet the new Krak Credit Card: up to 4% cashback on all purchases¹ appeared first on Kraken Blog.
